"""Deterministic recovery of a checkpointed transactional byte journal.

Reads newline-delimited JSON requests on stdin and writes one JSON response
per line. See the task contract for the binary record format and semantics.

import json
import sys
import zlib

HEADER_SIZE = 13          # payload_length:u32 | sequence:u32 | kind:u8 | transaction_id:u32
CRC_SIZE = 4
MAX_PAYLOAD = 4096

KIND_BEGIN = 1
KIND_PATCH = 2
KIND_COMMIT = 3
KIND_ABORT = 4


def solve(request):
    pages = [bytearray.fromhex(p) for p in request["pages"]]
    checkpoint = request["checkpoint"]
    log = bytes.fromhex(request["log"])
    n = len(log)

    pos = 0        # end of the valid prefix (in bytes)
    prev_seq = 0   # sequence of the last structurally valid record
    # txid -> [patch_count, running payload crc, [(page_index, offset, data), ...]]
    active = {}

    while True:
        remaining = n - pos
        if remaining < HEADER_SIZE:
            break  # incomplete record header
        payload_length = int.from_bytes(log[pos:pos + 4], "little")
        if payload_length > MAX_PAYLOAD:
            break  # invalid header
        record_size = HEADER_SIZE + payload_length + CRC_SIZE
        if remaining < record_size:
            break  # incomplete record body/crc
        if zlib.crc32(log[pos:pos + HEADER_SIZE + payload_length]) & 0xFFFFFFFF != \
                int.from_bytes(log[pos + HEADER_SIZE + payload_length:pos + record_size], "little"):
            break  # invalid CRC

        sequence = int.from_bytes(log[pos + 4:pos + 8], "little")
        kind = log[pos + 8]
        txid = int.from_bytes(log[pos + 9:pos + 13], "little")
        payload = log[pos + HEADER_SIZE:pos + HEADER_SIZE + payload_length]

        if sequence <= prev_seq:
            break  # invalid sequence (must be positive and strictly increasing)
        if txid == 0:
            break  # invalid transaction ID

        # Structural payload validation (required before any semantic effect).
        if kind == KIND_BEGIN or kind == KIND_ABORT:
            if payload_length != 0:
                break
            page_index = byte_offset = 0
        elif kind == KIND_PATCH:
            if payload_length < 6:
                break
            page_index = int.from_bytes(payload[0:2], "little")
            byte_offset = int.from_bytes(payload[2:4], "little")
            byte_count = int.from_bytes(payload[4:6], "little")
            if byte_count == 0 or payload_length != 6 + byte_count:
                break
            if page_index >= len(pages):
                break
            if byte_offset + byte_count > len(pages[page_index]):
                break
        elif kind == KIND_COMMIT:
            if payload_length != 8:
                break
        else:
            break  # invalid kind

        # The record is structurally valid: it joins the prefix.
        prev_seq = sequence
        pos += record_size

        # Transaction semantics.
        if kind == KIND_BEGIN:
            active[txid] = [0, 0, []]  # fresh incarnation; discards unfinished one
        elif kind == KIND_PATCH:

            if incarnation is not None:
                incarnation[0] += 1
                incarnation[1] = zlib.crc32(payload, incarnation[1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF
                incarnation[2].append((page_index, byte_offset, payload[6:]))
        elif kind == KIND_COMMIT:
            incarnation = active.pop(txid, None)
            if incarnation is not None and sequence > checkpoint:

                seal_digest = int.from_bytes(payload[4:8], "little")
                if seal_count == incarnation[0] and seal_digest == incarnation[1]:
                    for pi, off, data in incarnation[2]:

        else:  # KIND_ABORT
            active.pop(txid, None)

    return {
        "pages": [bytes(p).hex() for p in pages],
        "valid_bytes": pos,
        "last_seq": prev_seq,
    }
